source: Black & Gold Dispatch big board — our own ranking, not copied from any outside board
method: Two layers. 1) Formula from CollegeFootballData.com: production (0-45) blends multi-season volume (2026 + 0.6 x 2025) with efficiency, i.e. predicted points added per play for QB/RB/WR/TE; QBs also get completion %, yards per attempt and TD-to-INT. Plus recruiting pedigree (0-22; transfers keep their high-school rating; a low rating is a small minus, never a zero), strength of schedule (0-12, average SP+ of 2026 opponents), team quality (0-6), experience (0-5) and size fit (0-5), times a position-value factor (QB 1.15 ... RB 0.88). 2) Editorial scouting tier: our staff put about 70 notable prospects into tiers 1-6 (top-10 talent down to late-round) after reading many public scouting reports and forming our own view; each has a one-line reason in our words. For tiered players the final score is 25% formula and 75% tier (linemen 10/90); untiered players are formula-only at a small discount. Linemen have no box-score stats, so the tier carries them. Draft-eligible = 3+ years out of high school (redshirt sophomores included). No outside big board, rank order or write-up is copied. Players can return to school. Fan opinion, not a scouting report.
